TBD-0001.label: Contents of the 1970 village-green registration file (VG41), Civic Offices, Barry
unknown: The village green VG41 was registered on 16 June 1970 under the Commons Registration Act 1965. The registration file is kept by the Vale of Glamorgan Council, the registration authority, at the Civic Offices, Barry.
Contents not yet seen: the application and who made it, the statutory declaration, the map and its boundary, any objections, and the provisional and final registration notices.
Until the file is read, it is not known what evidence the registration rested on, or how the registered ground relates to Parcel A. Registration as a green does not by itself show who owns the land.
What would settle it: an inspection or copy of the whole VG41 file (requested; see MR-0017).

TBD-0002.label: Footage of the 1988 HTV/ITV Wales eviction news material not seen in the published clips
unknown: Two 1988 clips are published: the ITV Cymru Wales report (EV-0083) and a Wales at Six headline fragment broadcast on 5 December 1988. The National Library of Wales catalogues an HTV Wales videocassette, 'Eviction News Material, 30 November 1988' (item 507738), and a finding aid lists 11 ITV/HTV Wales news items from 1988–1989 (EV-0872).
The Legal Wiki's anomalies register records abrupt transitions and apparent omissions in an ITV clip (A-002).

Footage length not yet confirmed: it is not known how much material the archive copies hold beyond what the published clips show, whether the full news package of 5 December 1988 survives, or why the published fragment ends where it does.
Whether any footage was cut, withheld or never broadcast is an open question; nothing seen so far settles it.
What would settle it: viewing the archive copies with their timecodes and running times, and the broadcaster's own record of what was transmitted.

TBD-0006.label: Whether a wider plan for the land existed in 1988
unknown: In October–November 1988 BP's pension fund sold about 1,300 acres of Welsh land (EV-0270), and the Land Authority for Wales board considered neighbouring land (EV-0269).
Not established: whether the land at Great House Farm formed part of any wider plan, and whether the Williams family were consulted.
Cuts against: on every record seen so far, the farm itself stayed with BP until its 1993 sale to Ideal Homes.
What would settle it: the Land Authority board papers (WA 9/49; MR-0033), the full Cardiff Bay Development Corporation response, and the VG41 file (TBD-0001).

TBD-0007.label: Date of possession in November 1988 (29 or 30 November)
unknown: BP obtained possession at the end of November 1988, and the farmhouse was demolished on 6 December 1988.
Date not yet confirmed: the Legal Wiki has given 29 November; the South Wales Echo of 3 December 1988 (EV-0102) places the eviction on Wednesday, 30 November.
What would settle it: the enforcement record (the writ of possession and its execution return).
